about_the_game:
Fallout RPG - NPC Pack - Hollywood Heroes

Take a deeper look at the fascinating characters of the Amazon Fallout series in this tie-in NPC pack for Fallout: The Roleplaying Game. 

Adventure alongside Lucy, Maximus and The Ghoul in your own stories based on the show, or just play with the new toys on offer!

The 16 stat blocks in this NPC Pack are grouped into three main areas featured in the show along with additional information and plot hooks for each.

Adapted from the 31-page Hollywood Heroes product features:

  • Vault 33: Lucy Maclean, Chet, Norm Maclean, Woody Thomas, Stephanie Harper, and Overseer Hank Maclean. 

  • Brotherhood of Steel Camp: Maximus (in and out of armor) and Knight Titus.

  • Filly: The Ghoul, Dr Wilzig, CX404, Ma June, Barv, and the bounty hunters Honcho, Biggie, and Slim.

  • New Items: Brand new weapons, ammunition, armor, food, chems, and more.
